Thanks,

notes.title: Artificer's Tower Update: Twitch Integration and Game Tweaks!
notes.notes:
Good after morning!

I managed to steal some time away from Artificer's Tower over the holidays, but I still made progress for the upcoming Next Fest.

[h3]Twitch Integration![/h3]
Six years ago, when I first envisioned this game, Twitch integration was one of the initial features I planned. The goal was to enable Twitch streamers to seamlessly incorporate viewer names from chat and allow the chat to instigate some in-game chaos. While I haven't fully realized the latter, you can now integrate Twitch viewer names in a couple of ways. 

Firstly, the system can auto-assign names to new mages appearing in various game areas. For greater control, you can manually edit a mage’s name anytime using the Twitch icon, as shown below. This offers three options: select manually, choose randomly, or set up a draw in Twitch chat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225778/2978729dcc7aab8995b319e24d833bd77718a2a9.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225778/5b3a9e3689c13ed7e1c6f48da10258b79ad72317.png[/img]

[h3]Tweaks and More Tweaks[/h3]
Recently, I received crucial feedback about the steep difficulty spike after defeating a boss. It felt like suddenly shifting from fighting tier one enemies to tier two enemies after the next attack. To address this, I've modified the system to transition more gradually. This adjustment is also implemented in Custom Mode, allowing for complete control.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225778/9eefa16755d76f6b4fc996808f701aa8b97b164f.png[/img]

Honorable mentions:
[list]
[*] Added more tooltips for equipment and munitions for quick understanding of their functions.
[*] Introduced an in-stock toggle for the Item Selection window.
[*] Enhanced the munitions Glossary entry with additional details.
[*] Implemented a more efficient sorting system for the game windows.
[/list]

[h3]What's Next?[/h3]
The next update might be slightly delayed due to the hustle of the upcoming Next Fest and a challenging new feature I'm tackling: Controller support. Integrating controller functionality in a game like Artificer's Tower is no small feat, but it's a step towards making the game fully playable on the Steam Deck! Stay tuned for more updates.

Thanks for your ongoing support,
Jason
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225778/275f272a46ed5cbbe67e9ee0c5924b8b045ae0cb.png[/img]

notes.title: Intro + Demo Release!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I'm Jason, the creator of Artificer's Tower. My initial mission was to craft a small game, but I'm not very good at that! So here we are, five years later, launching on Steam with a game inspired by the design of Fallout Shelter, the management aspects of the Dwarf Fortress/Anno series, and the thrilling gameplay of the tower defense genre.

Artificer's Tower is about managing mages and building a tower while defending it. You'll find elements of resource management, crafting, happiness and wage systems, student training, and more designed to provide progression and challenge.

At this stage, I'm adding the final touches to the originally planned rooms and will soon switch gears to create more backgrounds. The roadmap below provides more details on the significant features and upcoming additions. (Which I completely forgot to add the backgrounds...)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225778/ae76904d0efa1cd927a7ab6532c7e3d070f66429.png[/img]

I'm also thrilled to announce that a demo version of Artificer's Tower is now available for anyone to try out. I've been developing this in a small bubble, so I'm eager for feedback. All constructive criticism is welcome!

As a solo developer on this project, I aim to provide regular updates. I'm committing to posting every two weeks here on Steam. Wishlist and follow Artificer's Tower to stay up to date.

Thanks, 
Jason
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225778/275f272a46ed5cbbe67e9ee0c5924b8b045ae0cb.png[/img]
